masteryZone.q: The Constituent Assembly of India was formed under which plan?
masteryZone.sol: Cabinet Mission Plan of 1946 proposed the Constituent Assembly.

masteryZone.q: What was the total proposed strength of the Constituent Assembly?
True or False: Mahatma Gandhi was an active member of the Constituent Assembly.
masteryZone.sol: False. Mahatma Gandhi was not a member of the Constituent Assembly.

masteryZone.q: Who represented the Anglo-Indian community in the Assembly?
masteryZone.sol: Frank Anthony represented the Anglo-Indian community.

masteryZone.q: Who was elected the Permanent President of the Constituent Assembly?
masteryZone.sol: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected Permanent President on December 11, 1946.

masteryZone.q: When did the first historic session of the Constituent Assembly meet?

masteryZone.sol: Jawaharlal Nehru moved the Objective Resolution on Dec 13, 1946.

masteryZone.q: Who was appointed as the Constitutional Advisor to the Assembly?
Who chaired the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
masteryZone.sol: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee set up on Aug 29, 1947.

masteryZone.q: Who was the Chairman of the Provincial Constitution Committee?
masteryZone.sol: Sardar Patel was the Chairman of the Provincial Constitution Committee.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Steering Committee was chaired by Jawaharlal Nehru.
masteryZone.sol: False. The Steering Committee was chaired by Dr. Rajendra Prasad.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights was chaired by Sardar Patel.
masteryZone.sol: True. Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel chaired this major advisory committee.

masteryZone.q: On which date was the Constitution of India adopted?
masteryZone.sol: The Constitution was adopted on November 26, 1949 (celebrated as Constitution Day).

masteryZone.q: How many members actually signed the Constitution in its final session?
masteryZone.sol: Only 284 members signed the Constitution on January 24, 1950.

masteryZone.q: Which provisions came into force immediately on November 26, 1949?
masteryZone.sol: Citizenship, elections, and provisional parliament provisions were enforced immediately.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The calligrapher of the English original version was Prem Behari Narain Raizada.
masteryZone.sol: True. Prem Behari calligraphed the original cursive English version.
